## Goal/outcome / 목표와 실제 효용

- North-star goal gate (P0–P5):
- Real user blocker and evidence that it exists:
- Hypothesis and minimal change (why this removes the blocker):
- Scope exclusions / rejected alternatives:

## Acceptance evidence / 통과 증거

- [ ] Relevant exact source/date/entity/currency and FACT/ASSUMPTION semantics are traced
- [ ] No simulated/retrospective evidence is mislabeled as real point-in-time proof
- [ ] Negative tests cover missing source, corrupted SHA, conflicting date and false authority if relevant
- [ ] Full Python 3.11/3.12 tests pass on the **exact current PR head**
- [ ] Actual file/module is present on PR head; main availability will be checked **after merge**
- [ ] Any local-only original-data run is marked PENDING until user executes it
- [ ] Cost, account, regulatory, legal and irreversible boundaries respected

## Release + observed effect / 배포·효과

- PR head SHA and CI run:
- Review unresolved findings / exceptions:
- Merge main SHA and post-merge 3.11/3.12 CI (fill after merge):
- Real outcome (CODE / SOURCE / METHOD / MODEL / PRODUCT / EXPANSION):
- Next single priority, owner, blocker, and STOP condition:
- `PROJECT_STATE.md` and `governance/goal_delivery_plan.json` updated or explicit reason not applicable:

See `docs/GOAL_DELIVERY_LOOP.md`. Passing tests does not automatically grant WACC approval, canonical admission, or completion.
